verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a work-tracking SaaS like Jira, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a Jira mobile app or mobile parity with desktop. The pack covers views, workflows, integrations, APIs, sandboxes and community complaints about the web UI, none of which address mobile.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
